patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose commercetools only if your buying job matches “Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sale” rather than Ecwid's shape. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than commercetools's shape. Workflow advantage: commercetools leans wholesale-b2b; Ecwid leans checkout-conversion. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: commercetools is Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sales. Shopify keeps the SaaS award.; Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);.
- Company-size focus: commercetools (mid-market, enterprise) vs Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: commercetools-leaning wholesale-b2b vs Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion.
- Researched limits: commercetools — No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products.

Limitations — commercetools: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square.

Poor-fit cases: commercetools is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet · Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · Avoid commercetools if you actually need Ecwid's motion (Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 a)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
